name: ….Wait, What Did I Just Read?
source:
This is a game about nothing. It’s also a game about turtles. It’s also a game about cavemen. It’s also a game about whatever you want it to be.

…Wait, What Did I Just Read? is an experiment in collaboration, vagueness, and what can be done with a visual novel. I wrote a short story that should take only 5 minutes to read, and provided no art to go with it. I then encouraged readers to make their own art and send it to me, so it could be included in the game. As more people add their own art, everyone can see a different way the story can be interpreted.

[From [url=http://twinturtlegames.com/games/wait-what-did-i-just-read/]TwinTurtle Games[/url]]
